options.reason: The table was evidently assembled to predict the binary anaemia diagnosis in Result from routine CBC indices, matching the brief: compare standard classifiers on Gender, MCH, MCHC and MCV, then report discrimination, calibration, learning curve and SHAP attributions. Hemoglobin is flagged as a leakage suspect because anaemia status is clinically defined by haemoglobin thresholds, so a model given it would largely recapitulate the labelling rule rather than demonstrate independent prediction; a haemoglobin-free model (or an explicit with/without contrast) is the defensible main analysis. No group or time columns exist, since each row is a single cross-sectional blood count.
